purpose: End-to-end full-resolution import of a relocated native RCP containing two real adjacent FARO stations through the Desktop SCAN API and durable worker.
acceptance: The current Desktop API, durable queue worker, full native RCS import, and station identity passed for this moved two-station package. point_count equals ingested_count for both stations with max_points=0. The RCP manifest still declares 1,311,147 more points in total than the native reader produced; the reason is unresolved. Both nodes remain registered=false. ReCap GUI open/save/reopen has not been performed. Stage 2 remains open.
limitations: This is a two-station integration check, not a rerun of all 810 stations in the isolated Desktop database.
A max_points=0 setting and matching stored/reader counts do not explain the discrepancy from RCP-declared counts.
This does not verify registration, coordinate alignment, or ReCap GUI acceptance.
The worker run was local to this workstation and the shared API on port 8000 was not changed.
